mapper.select: SELECT t.trade_id AS tradeId, o.order_id AS orderId, CAST(o.total_fee AS SIGNED) AS totalFee, CAST(o.freight_fee AS SIGNED) AS freightFee, o.receipt_type AS receiptType, COALESCE(r.refund_fee, 0) AS refundFee, t.pay_type AS payType FROM orders_normal_orders o LEFT JOIN trade t ON o.order_id = t.order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_fee) AS refund_fee FROM aftersales_refund a WHERE refund_status IN ('AUDIT_SUCCESS', 'SUCCESS', 'CHANGE') GROUP BY order_id ) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.company_id = #{companyId} AND o.distributor_id = #{distributorId} AND t.trade_state = 'SUCCESS' AND IFNULL(t.is_settled, 0) <> 1 AND o.order_auto_close_aftersales_time > 0 AND o.order_auto_close_aftersales_time < #{endTime} AND o.order_id NOT IN ( SELECT order_id FROM aftersales_refund WHERE refund_status IN ('READY', 'PROCESSING') ) ORDER BY o.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.trade_id AS tradeId, t.pay_type AS payType, o.order_id AS orderId, CAST(o.total_fee AS SIGNED) AS totalFee, CAST(o.cost_fee AS SIGNED) AS costFee, CAST(o.freight_fee AS SIGNED) AS freightFee, o.receipt_type AS receiptType, COALESCE(r.refund_fee, 0) AS refundFee, CAST(o.commission_fee AS SIGNED) AS commissionFee, COALESCE(o.point_fee, 0) AS pointFee, o.item_fee AS itemFee, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.pay_status AS payStatus, ono.order_auto_close_aftersales_time AS orderAutoCloseAftersalesTime, ono.supplier_id AS onoSupplierId FROM supplier_order o LEFT JOIN trade t ON o.order_id = t.order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_fee) AS refund_fee FROM aftersales_refund a WHERE refund_status IN ('AUDIT_SUCCESS', 'SUCCESS', 'CHANGE') AND supplier_id = #{operatorId} GROUP BY order_id ) r ON o.order_id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN orders_normal_orders ono ON ono.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.company_id = #{companyId} AND o.supplier_id = #{operatorId} AND t.trade_state = 'SUCCESS' AND IFNULL(o.is_settled, 0) = 0 AND ono.order_auto_close_aftersales_time > 0 AND ono.order_auto_close_aftersales_time < #{endTime} AND o.order_id NOT IN ( SELECT order_id FROM aftersales_refund WHERE refund_status IN ('READY', 'PROCESSING') ) ORDER BY o.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(C.refunded_fee), 0) AS refundedFee, IFNULL(SUM(C.refunded_point), 0) AS refundedPoint, IFNULL(SUM(D.cost_price * COALESCE(A.num, 0)), 0) AS refundCostFee FROM aftersales_detail A LEFT JOIN aftersales_refund C ON A.aftersales_bn = C.aftersales_bn LEFT JOIN items D ON A.item_id = D.item_id WHERE A.company_id = #{companyId} AND A.order_id = #{orderId} AND C.refund_status IN ('AUDIT_SUCCESS', 'SUCCESS') AND C.supplier_id = #{operatorId} GROUP BY A.order_id
